title: MN 26 — The Noble Search (Pāsarāsi/Ariyapariyesanā Sutta)
scope: First-person going-forth, teachers, ascetic search and awakening sequence
limitations: Canonical textual attestation is not eyewitness verification. The passage does not contain every later palace, horse or companion detail used in visual biography.

title: MN 123 — Incredible and Amazing (Acchariyaabbhūta Sutta)
scope: Canonical miraculous birth narrative of the bodhisatta
limitations: The source establishes textual tradition, not the historicity of miraculous details or the date of the modern relief.

title: Ja 533 — Cūḷahaṃsa Jātaka, Nālāgiri frame narrative
scope: Pali narrative attestation of the Nālāgiri elephant episode
limitations: A translated narrative witness supports identification of the story, not the historicity of every episode or a unique match to a relief whose local caption is unreadable.

title: The Mahāvaṃsa or Great Chronicle of Ceylon — Chapter I
date: chronicle composed c. fifth–sixth century CE; Geiger translation 1912
author_or_institution: Wilhelm Geiger translation / Pali Text Society tradition
scope: Chronicle narrative of the Buddha's visits to Mahiyangana and Nāgadīpa and the yakkha/nāga episodes
limitations: Primary for what the chronicle says, not independent corroboration that the historical Buddha travelled to Sri Lanka.

title: An Historical Relation of the Island Ceylon — natural strength and narrow ways
author_or_institution: Robert Knox / public-domain Project Gutenberg edition
scope: Contemporary outsider description of the highland kingdom's natural strength and narrow routes
limitations: Knox observes topography and route width. He does not explicitly document a formal Kandyan state policy of deliberate non-road-building.
